title: Modern Downtown Apartment
description: Beautiful modern apartment in the heart of downtown San Francisco. Features include hardwood floors, stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and floor-to-ceiling windows with stunning city views. Walking distance to restaurants, shops, and public transportation.

title: Spacious Family Home with Pool
description: Stunning family home featuring 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and a gorgeous backyard with an in-ground pool. The home includes a gourmet kitchen, formal dining room, large master suite with walk-in closet, and a two-car garage. Perfect for entertaining and family living.

title: Luxury Beachfront Condo
description: Experience luxury living in this stunning beachfront condo with panoramic ocean views. Features include an open-concept living space, chef's kitchen with premium appliances, spa-like bathrooms, and a private balcony. Building amenities include 24-hour concierge, fitness center, and private beach access.

title: Charming Victorian Townhouse
description: Beautifully restored Victorian townhouse in historic Boston neighborhood. Original architectural details including crown molding, hardwood floors, and decorative fireplaces. Updated kitchen and bathrooms while maintaining period charm. Private rooftop deck with city views.

title: Cozy Studio Apartment
description: Affordable studio apartment in a great New York location. Features include an efficient layout, modern kitchen, updated bathroom, and plenty of natural light. Close to subway stations, parks, and local amenities. Perfect for young professionals or students.

title: Prime Commercial Property
description: Excellent commercial property in prime Chicago location. Suitable for retail, office, or mixed-use development. High visibility location with ample parking. Building features include modern HVAC system, updated electrical, and flexible floor plan. Great investment opportunity.

title: Test Suburban House
description: This is a lovely suburban house perfect for families. Features include a spacious backyard, modern kitchen, and quiet neighborhood.
